exact_claim: For the same fixed short Q crossing and its completed weighted phi space V_A, the exact nonlinear energy is not finite on any weighted neighborhood of the background. A direction with psi prime proportional to abs(x)^(-1/2) is in V_A but has infinite exact field energy at every nonzero amplitude. Even on smooth fixed-wall phi-only finite-energy perturbations with unchanged density/scale/mass, the single dimensionally restored beta=3/8 bump family tends to zero in V_A with norm squared of order delta^(1/4), while its exact equilibrium-linear-subtracted full energy is asymptotic to a positive constant times delta^(-1/4). Thus continuity and uniform quadratic Taylor control in this weighted topology fail. Finite exact field energy at fixed bounded scale requires the ordinary L2 gradient/H1 potential domain. The prior linear form/operator/evolution theorem survives and no nonlinear instability or ghost is inferred.
